title: Woman Sitting on Porch, 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photograph
description: A 1920s sepia-toned vintage snapshot depicting a young woman sitting on the stone-base edge of a house porch. She is dressed in a classic 1920s checkered pattern day dress with knee-length hemline and short sleeves, featuring a casual short haircut typical of the decade's everyday fashion. Behind her is a lush grove of trees or orchard. The photograph has visible vertical creasing and black paper mounting remnants on the reverse side.
